info.title: Locus file catalog
info.description: Catalog on the ship. File bytes stay on ZFS behind a host gateway and are addressed by SHA-256. Folders are implied by entries plus explicitly created folders. Writes use expectedRevision; stale saves return conflict (409). Errors use the envelope {ok:false, error, message} with HTTP 400, 404 or 409 as applicable.

post.summary: Create an entry {dir, name, sha256, size, mime}

put.summary: Patch {dir, name} (rename or move); expectedRevision required

delete.summary: Delete; optional expectedRevision query (404 if missing, 409 if stale)

get.summary: Sorted unique folder paths implied by entries plus explicit folders

delete.summary: Delete folder ?path=/x; 409 if any entry is under it
